corroborating_sources.note: Genuine CBE export of the same exam series and date (different shift) with its own distinct SSC Question ID set - corroborates that multiple shifts were actually held on 02-Aug-2023 and that the per-section CBE conventions used here are correct. corroborating_sources.note: Independently lists CHSL Tier-1 2023 papers for 02 Aug 2023 with the 100 Questions / 200 Marks / 60 Mins pattern, corroborating the existence of this date. (Testbook's actual paper PDFs are login-gated; not used as a question source.)

notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE exam-screen export for the exact date+shift (header Exam Date 02/08/2023, SSC Question IDs + one candidate's responses throughout), but the source PDF's text layer is only partially recoverable in this environment: the English section (Q1-25) stems are fully recovered (options partially - image-only options marked [NOT RECOVERABLE]); the Reasoning, Quant and GA sections are almost entirely image-only - stems/options recovered where the text layer leaked them (Reasoning Q33 numeric series, Q49 mirror-image stem, Q50 rectangles stem; Quant Q51-55, Q59, Q60-65, Q68-71 options/stems; GA Q78 stem); everything else is marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] and has NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. SECTION ORDER on the CBE screen for CHSL 2023 Tier I: 1) English Language (Q.1-25), 2) General Intelligence (Q.1-25), 3) Quantitative Aptitude (Q.1-25), 4) General Awareness (Q.1-25). The CBE numbers questions 1-25 WITHIN each section; this file uses global numbering 1-100 in that section order (English=1-25, Reasoning=26-50, Quant=51-75, GA=76-100); the original per-section SSC question_id is recorded for every question where present. UNRECOVERED AT ALL: Quant section-questions 11-12 (global 61-62, not present in the parsed layer at all) and GA section-questions 17-25 (global 92-100, fall off the end of the parsed text layer) - no SSC Question IDs for them. UNATTRIBUTED FRAGMENT: a DI table (Class V/VI/VII/VIII, Boys/Girls, values 65 58 59 60 62 61 58 57 59 54 52 52) with leaked options 4/3, 3/4, 7/4 and 'Status: Not Answered' appears in the Quant text layer between the recoverable Q.10 and Q.13 - it belongs to section-question 11 or 12 but the two cannot be distinguished from the layout, so it is listed here and NOT attached to a question number. LEAKED-FRAGMENT ATTRIBUTION CONVENTION: text-layer fragments that appear directly after a question's own Question-ID + Status block are attributed (as probable) to that question, because the following question in every such case carries its own complete ID + Status block; this is a layout inference, flagged per-question with 'attribution ... probable'. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: recorded per question in answer_note as reference only; they are NOT official answers. KEY-MARK ARTIFACTS: several source tables embed check-mark ('correct') and 'X' marks next to options (e.g. English Q12-15, Q18, Q19; Reasoning Q33). These are Adda247's answer-key notation inside the export; they are UNVERIFIED against the SSC official key and in at least one case (English Q13) the embedded mark contradicts the recorded candidate choice, so they are recorded in answer_note only and never used to set correct_answer. ANSWERS: the official CHSL 2023 answer key (final key published 19-Aug-2023 per SSC notice) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in with roll number + password; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment, so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null. Do not treat any embedded mark or candidate choice as an official answer.
